# Chapter register {#sec-chapter-register}

The register lists every chapter with its guiding question, intended readers, prerequisites, learning activity,
course workshop and primary source. It is also available as a machine-readable file:
[`editorial/chapter-register.csv`](https://github.com/CTTIR/clinical-data-science-in-r/blob/main/editorial/chapter-register.csv).


::: {#tbl-chapter-register .cell tbl-cap='Chapters B01–B28 with guiding question, course workshop and lab.'}
